items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: He got the tones and he can play anything Stan Getz, any guy, so now he's up on his instrument.

ctx.x: on tenor, see, but what's happening (inaudible) this year. (Inaudible) with Frank and those people, they didn't give him a chance (inaudible). But out here, we school him and he's got his tape recorder and if he have to play a solo (inaudible), he play it. He can write anything and he play all the way anything Hirshel play, he play it all the way. He got the tones and he can play anything Stan Getz, any guy, so now he's up on his instrument. Then he copies me in solo work. A lot of things I do, he do it, too. So…
What's the name of the place?
